scope: Reconcile current peer reports about ACIS entity omission and mutable object-graph writing with the exact local legacy-SAT, modern SAB/ACDSDATA, and dynamic-block qualification boundaries.

method.kind: Primary repository issue/PR status review, Autodesk DXF entity reference review, and local plan cross-check
method.scopeNote: Public issue/PR descriptions and contributor reports are evidence of reported project state and failure leads, not independent reproduction or normative format authority.

evidence.topic: ACadSharp ACIS DXF writer readiness and solid-only block loss
evidence.observed: On 2026-10-16, issue #1195 remained open and reported silent 3DSOLID/REGION omission in ACadSharp 3.4.9, including solid-only blocks becoming empty. PR #1240 remained open and undeployed; its description depends on the ACDS/ACIS schema refactor PR #1174. No peer branch or reported customer file was run in this review.
doesNotEstablish: behavior of current ACadSharp master or a released ACadSharp build
correctness of PR #1240 or complete SAB/ACDSDATA semantics
native CAD acceptance or valid ACIS geometry
evidence.planUse: Keep S2.3.9.4.29 closed only for its generated legacy-SAT scope. Gate AC1027+ SAB/ACDSDATA block output separately with per-handle owner/block/INSERT and payload-association closure, or transactional refusal.

evidence.topic: Dynamic-block graph mutation versus fixed-point replay
evidence.observed: Issue #1133 was closed by merged PR #1151. The PR description states that original dynamic blocks can be emitted intact while modified instances lose their parameter relationships. A contributor report in the issue also described dictionary entries left pointing at objects filtered as unsupported, and proposed real AutoCAD COM AUDIT as an optional verification route.
doesNotEstablish: an independently reproduced current peer failure
normative dynamic-block or dictionary omission policy
that a no-op round trip is invalid for every static object graph
that AutoCAD COM is available or appropriate as a fast test dependency
evidence.planUse: Before enabling mutable object-graph output, require both fixed-point and supported read-modify-write cases, emitted-handle/reference closure, and a no-partial-output negative for unsupported targets. Keep AutoCAD audit checks optional at a composed checkpoint.

evidence.topic: 3DSOLID outer DXF references and payload framing
evidence.observed: Autodesk's DXF table identifies ordered proprietary group-1/group-3 data and an optional history-owner handle for 3DSOLID. The local plan separately models inline SAT/SAB, ACDSDATA association, DWG DataStorage, owner/block paths, and semantic geometry; therefore record presence or byte presence alone is insufficient closure evidence.
doesNotEstablish: the inner ACIS/ASM grammar or save-version interpretation
the DWG AcDs/DataStorage join contract beyond already admitted local profiles
semantic solid validity from DXF carrier retention
evidence.planUse: Reuse existing S2.3 identity and association gates; add only the missing eligible modern block-contained owner-link controls to the existing test owner, without inventing DWG layout or serializer behavior.

implementationReadiness.fixturePolicy: No external sample was downloaded or added. Future positive/negative controls are generated locally in temporary/build storage.
implementationReadiness.externalPeerValidation: Optional and composed-checkpoint-only; ACadSharp PR branches are not treated as release capabilities.
